rate_table_note: Rates are the schedule in R.S. 9:3542 C ("Amount per $100.00"), by months (0-6 to more than 108 through 120) and 7-, 14- or 30-day retroactive benefits; only retroactive coverage may be sold. The schedule is not dated in the text; January 1, 1998 is the date the section's current text took effect. The section was last amended by Acts 1997, No. 143, eff. Jan. 1, 1998. R.S. 6:969.25 (motor vehicle credit transactions, Acts 1999, No. 794) sets the same figures; R.S. 9:3332 (consumer leases) sets higher credit life rates.
source_title: La. R.S. 9:3542, Requirement of insurance (Louisiana Consumer Credit Law; Louisiana State Legislature)
summary: Rates in force: Louisiana's maximum retroactive credit health and accident rates for consumer credit transactions in R.S. 9:3542 C, per $100, for terms of more than 6 through 12 and more than 48 through 60 months. The section's current text took effect January 1, 1998; whether that amendment changed this schedule was not checked.
